name: Gepang Gath
notes: Named among critical hotspots in the MHA GLOF review (Sept 2026) and among nine rapidly expanding lakes in the IIT Mandi study. Seed point located from 2025 Sentinel-2 imagery with `aahat discover`.

name: Lam Dal
notes: Largest glacial lake on the Dhauladhar (OSM way 62047916), 0.18 km2 in 2025, seed placed from imagery. IIT Mandi names a 'Kalikund' (Kangra/Chamba) among nine fast-growing lakes, but the two OSM Kali Kund ponds nearby are far too small for the reported ~120,000 m2 growth, so we monitor Lam Dal and do not attribute that figure to it.

name: Lake south of Sangla (Baspa)
notes: Found by the 2025 high-altitude sweep (aahat sweep) and placed from Sentinel-2 imagery; no name in OpenStreetMap. Drains to the Baspa, past the Baspa and Karcham Wangtoo hydro projects, into the Sutlej.

name: Lake north of Sangla (Baspa)
notes: Found by the 2025 high-altitude sweep (aahat sweep) and placed from Sentinel-2 imagery; no name in OpenStreetMap. Kinnaur's Sangla area lakes are among those the state has proposed for early warning.
